read.title: Notice of Price Adjustment
read.text:
Dear Mr. Silva,

We value our partnership and want to inform you of an upcoming change. Due to rising costs of raw materials and packaging, we will apply a 4% price increase to our skincare line.

The new prices will be effective from February 1. Over the past year, we absorbed most of these costs, but we can no longer do so without lowering quality.

All orders confirmed before January 31 will keep the current prices. Please find attached the updated price list.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.task: 원가 상승으로 3월부터 단가를 3% 올려야 해요. 오래 거래한 바이어에게 인상 이유와 적용 날짜를 알리고, 그 전 주문은 기존 가격을 유지한다고 써 보세요.
write.en: Tell a long-time buyer about a 3% price increase from March, explain why, and say earlier orders keep the current price.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Chen,

We value our partnership and want to let you know early. Due to rising costs of ingredients and shipping, our unit prices will increase by 3%, effective from March 1. Any orders placed before that date will keep the current prices. Please find attached the new price list.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
